Statistics from the KILLING FLOOR (www.brucespringsteen.it) database

Published on the following official releases:

  • THE RIVER (Album,1980)
  • FADE AWAY / THE TIES THAT BIND (7 in.,1981)
  • SHERRY DARLING 'RENNBAHN EXPRESS' (7 in.,1981)
  • THE TIES THAT BIND / I'M A ROCKER (7 in.,1981)
  • THE PROMISE-DVD3 (Album,2010)
  • THE TIES THAT BIND : RIVER SINGLE ALBUM (Album,2015)
First known live performance: 01/11/1978 Princeton University, Princeton,NJ ,USA
Last known live performance: 14/02/2017 Brisbane Entertainment Centre, Brisbane ,Australia

Song 'history':


25 perfomances were given during the Darkness tour
Published on the double album THE RIVER, in 1980
Often played during the River tour (77 times)
A frequent number (49 apparitions) of renderings during the Reunion tour
Bruce inserted it 30 times in the setlists of the Rising tour
Played during the Vote For Change tour, in October 2004.
Just less than a dozen shots during the Devils and Dust tour
Played during the rehearsals for the Magic tour, in Sep 2007.
Bruce inserted it 15 times in the setlists of the Magic tour
Just less than a dozen shots during the Working on a Dream tour
Published in live version in the 3rd DVD: House Cut 'Houston '78 of 'The Promise'
Played during the Wrecking Ball tour (25 times)
Scarcely used during the High Hopes tour, with 4 inclusions
This song was due to be included, in 1980, in the THE RIVER single album projects, and has been later released on the THE TIES THAT BIND Anniversary Box
Widely used in the 2016 The River tour, as it was performed 62 times
Performed 6 times during the 2017 Summer tour
Data from the www.brucespringsteen.it database
